results.item: Lighthouse performance >= 80 on the deployed URL
results.detail: Measured 46.0/100 on the locally served Streamlit app (desktop preset): LCP 2.7 s, TBT 910 ms, 1262 KB total payload. Below the 80 target — the cost is Streamlit's ~1.2 MB JS runtime and hydration (TBT dominates), not application code. Mitigations shipped: minimal toolbar, no web fonts, no external analytics, server-side PNG pre-rendering of blink frames. Meeting >=80 would require leaving Streamlit for a static/Next.js shell — documented as deferred, not claimed as a pass.
